categories.main_business_segments: China National Nuclear Power Co., Ltd. (CNNP) primarily operates in nuclear power generation, renewable energy including wind and solar power, and related technical services. The company also engages in nuclear energy multi-purpose utilization, nuclear power technology services, and comprehensive energy services. Its business segments include nuclear power operation, new energy development, strategic emerging industries, and nuclear power technology services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced nuclear reactor technologies such as the independently developed Hualong One (third-generation pressurized water reactor), CP300, CP600, CP1000, VVER-1000, VVER-1200, AP1000, CAP1000, and CANDU-6 heavy water reactors. It emphasizes safety through active and passive safety design integration and employs digital and intelligent management systems for plant operation and maintenance. The company also invests in emerging clean technologies like perovskite solar cells and energy storage systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CNNP's primary customers are regional power grid companies across China, including State Grid Corporation's regional branches and provincial power companies in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Fujian, Hainan, and others. The company serves the electricity market with nuclear and renewable energy power supply and provides nuclear technology services. It also explores overseas markets with projects in Pakistan and Kazakhstan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with nuclear power plants and renewable energy projects distributed across more than 20 provinces including Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Fujian, Hainan, Liaoning, and others. It has overseas investments and projects in countries such as Pakistan and Kazakhstan. Headquarters and main administrative offices are located in Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: CNNP operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the nuclear and renewable energy supply chain, focusing on power generation, project construction, operation, and technical services. It is supported upstream by its controlling shareholder China National Nuclear Corporation, which provides uranium mining, nuclear fuel manufacturing, and nuclear technology development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes nuclear safety, high-quality development, and innovation-driven growth. R&D focuses on improving reactor performance, extending plant life, nuclear multi-purpose utilization (e.g., hydrogen production, heat supply), digital transformation, and emerging clean technologies like perovskite solar cells and energy storage. It emphasizes collaboration with universities and research institutes and aims to enhance core technology self-reliance and industrialization.
categories.revenue_model: CNNP generates revenue mainly through electricity sales from nuclear and renewable energy plants to power grid companies. Additional income streams include nuclear technology services, consulting, and management fees from entrusted operations. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a leading nuclear power operator in China, CNNP holds a dominant market position with the largest installed nuclear capacity and ongoing construction projects. It competes with other major Chinese nuclear power companies and renewable energy firms. The company is recognized for its advanced technology, operational safety, and comprehensive clean energy portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, CNNP reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 74.96 billion, a 5.15% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.62 billion, up 17.91%. Total assets reached RMB 539.27 billion, growing 16.01%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory with expanding nuclear and renewable energy capacity and continuous profitability improvement.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CNNP emphasizes its commitment to safe, stable, and efficient nuclear power generation with leading global operational performance. It offers low-carbon, clean energy solutions aligned with China's carbon neutrality goals. The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary nuclear technologies, integrated energy services, innovation in emerging clean technologies, and a robust industrial chain supported by its controlling shareholder.
